label: Cal hat
units: rig px (design/rig/rig.json canvas [640, 900], anchor [320, 852]); every SVG uses absolute rig coordinates with viewBox = box
notes: The approved canonical v2 Cal hat (painted), not redrawn. Uses the rig head variant hatclip, as the rig does.
"Cal" is on the front only; walk_back sprites use the logo-free bear_hat_back.png.

fit.frame: canonical Cal hat (rig hat_front/hd == v2 hatcomp canonical placement)
fit.per_head_scale: for an age/build head variant: s = head_width / 396, about anchor, then move anchor to the variant crown-base centre
fit.v2_sprites: rig px -> v2 hat-stand px: x = (x_rig - 49) / 2.5 + 3, y = (y_rig - 45) / 2.5 + 3; then apply hatc/bear_match.json per pose like the canonical hat

views.rule: hide this item (or fall back to no accessory) on unsupported poses; never paste the front view on a turned head
views.note: only the front layers ship here; the canonical logo-free back (sprites/v2/hat_layers/bear_hat_back.png) and the view-matched layers in progress under sprites/v2/hat_layers/views/ should be wired as they land
